paragraphs: Mentioned in Mishnah Yoma, chapter 6, mishnah 3: R' Yose said, “It once happened that Arsela led the scapegoat, and he was a lay Israelite”—neither a priest nor a Levite.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Arsela is the subject leading the scapegoat, not the object being led or a place-name in this syntax. The source parenthesis supplies the goat referent. ישראל is lay Israelite; Hyman’s gloss excludes both priest and Levite, not one-who-was-not a priest. Vowels/identity remain unverified.
פ״ו מ״ג is 6m 3, without a fresh named check. Yose’s compressed title remains R'; the source’s parenthetical explanations are integrated in sense without a claim of verbatim Mishnah wording.
